name: Local Book Get
summary: Local Book Search: find a book on an online mirror and resolve its download URL. Use --download-dir to save it.
description: Search LibGen or Anna’s Archive with publication-year ordering. Select an exact file, navigate its download page, prefer slow partner downloads, and wait for the actual file link. Use --agent-output for bounded retries.

query.description: Book to find: title, author, or both (e.g. 'Brave New World Huxley'). Searches all columns.

base_url.description: Optional book source base URL. Include the trailing slash.

format.description: Desired file extension, matched exactly against the Ext. column. Defaults to epub. Common: epub, pdf, mobi, azw3, djvu.

language.description: Optional language preference (e.g. English). When set and at least one matching-format row has that language, selection is restricted to it; otherwise ignored.

result_index.description: Which matching candidate to pick (0 = first/best). Use book/search first to inspect candidates, then pick a different index here.

selected_md5.description: Exact file selector supplied internally when retrieving a search result ID. Never substitutes another file.

sort.description: Publication year: year_desc (newest), year_asc (oldest), or relevance. Unknown years sort last. LibGen sorts the loaded page; Anna uses server sorting.

mirror_urls.description: Comma-separated fallback source base URLs, tried in order with --agent-output; maximum three total attempts.

max_attempts.description: Maximum attempts with --agent-output, including the first source. Get advances slow partner servers between attempts.

mirror_index.description: Slow partner link index, starting at zero. Agent output increments this on retries.

help.summary: Local Book Search: find a book on an online mirror and resolve its download URL. Use --download-dir to save it.

parameters.base_url: Optional book source base URL. Include the trailing slash.
parameters.result_index: Which matching candidate to pick (0 = first).
parameters.selected_md5: Internal exact file selector; agent callers use id instead.
parameters.sort: Publication year: year_desc (newest), year_asc (oldest), or relevance. Unknown years sort last. LibGen sorts the loaded page; Anna uses server sorting.
parameters.mirror_urls: Comma-separated fallback source base URLs, tried in order with --agent-output; maximum three total attempts.
parameters.max_attempts: Maximum attempts with --agent-output, including the first source. Get advances slow partner servers between attempts.
parameters.mirror_index: Get: slow partner link index, starting at zero. Agent output increments this on retries.

examples.command: rzn-browser run book get --param query="Brave New World Huxley" --download-dir ~/Books/bnw
rzn-browser run book get --param query="Pride and Prejudice Austen" --param format=pdf --param language=English --download-dir ~/Books/austen
rzn-browser run book get --param query="Dune Herbert" --param result_index=1 --download-dir ~/Books/dune

returns: Object: { found, status, chosen{title,author,...,md5}, download_url, attachment_urls:[{url,filename}] }. Run with --download-dir <folder> to save the file to <folder>/attachments/.

found=false carries status (no_table | no_format_match | no_download_link) and error; no_format_match also lists available_formats so you can retry with a different format. no_table usually means the book source layout is unsupported — try another base_url.
notes: Supports the LibGen table layout and Anna’s Archive result cards.
Anna’s Archive uses native publication-year sorting; LibGen sorts all loaded rows before applying limit.
Get navigates through source pages and only slow partner links; persistent verification needs human input.
Use --agent-output for at most three attempts; ordinary mode exposes mirror_index and base_url for explicit retries.
